I wrote the proposal to `research/b3/proposals/P-015.json`. It is a WIN-only rule on a 1-minute clock. Each half-hour slot from 09:30 to 17:30 is traded in the direction that same slot moved, on average, over the previous 20 sessions, but only when that average is at least 0.05% and at least one standard error from zero. The bet is that institutions running multi-day orders through fixed-schedule algorithms (VWAP and market-on-close) push the same clock slots the same way each day and pay a repeatable price impact.
